title: Au café: a role-play
description: Order drinks and food in a French café, ask what there is and what it costs, ask for the bill, pay and thank: from a supported dialogue to a free role-play.

sources.title: Pourboire (Wikipédia)
sources.note: In France cafés and restaurants must include the service charge in their prices; a tip is neither required nor expected; people often round up small bills.

sources.title: café (Larousse, dictionnaire français-anglais)
sources.note: café crème: coffee with cream; petit noir: a small cup of strong black coffee; café au lait: coffee with milk.

sources.title: Expresso (Wikipédia)
sources.note: *Café noisette*: an espresso with a little milk foam; *café allongé*: more water than an espresso.

sources.title: Euro (Wikipédia)
sources.note: In France the cent is called centime.

sources.title: Tutoiement et vouvoiement en français (Wikipédia)
sources.note: Vous with people you do not know, such as a waiter; tu among young people.
